<div class="card-body">
'''Leesub Sirln''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Leesub Sirln]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4029). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">リーサブ・サーリン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、１フォース消費して相手の手札を１枚選び、カードのタイプを予測する。カードを公開し、あたればロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-leesub-sirln-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">リーサブは、人類の近縁種クイラッシュで、奴隷として育てられた。限定された未来予知の能力を持つ。帝国の高等調査官トレメインによって、フォースの達人と認められたが、脱走してモス・アイズリーに身を潜める。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leesub Sirln.

'''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, use 1 Force to select a card from your opponent's hand and predict its card type. Reveal the card. If your prediction is correct, the card is lost.

'''Lore:''' Leesub is a near-human Qiraash who was raised as a slave. She has a limited ability to foresee the future. Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne recognized her as an adept of the Force, but she escaped and went into hiding in Mos Eisley.
